mentions.name: HNowledge
mentions.description: This free iOS app lets users browse the Hacker News stories and comments they've upvoted, synced from HN. It supports browsing by date, domain, or score, adding notes, and exporting, with all data kept local and no tracking.
mentions.problem: The author upvotes HN content they find interesting so they can come back to it later, and wanted a browsing experience for those upvotes that fits that workflow.
mentions.source_excerpt: Then also HNowledge[1], a free iOS app for browsing the HN stories and comments I've upvoted. Made it to fit the way I browse HN, which is upvoting mainly what I find interesting and may want to come back to. The app lets you browse by date, domain or score, add notes and export. Apart from syncing your upvotes from HN, everything stays local without any tracking.
